answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities a losing bet. Each new agent pays a sunk toll of 40 credits, like a comet burning fuel it never recovers. It cannot be resold or refunded, so 100 fake names cost 4,000 credits up front for no gain. Costs spiral as copies multiply, since every duplicate pays the full toll again. Honest agents pay once and trade in the oasis of verified peers, earnings undiluted. The toll equals twice 30 days of expected profit.
